title: Rediscovering The Prayer Life of Jesus
paragraphs: He is our Lord. We follow him and he had a lifestyle based on prayer. Therefore, we would like to focus on revealing his principles in seeking knowledge, and his lifestyle in prayer. I want to start with some comments about prayer. Prayer is not an option for a Christian, a believer, or a citizen of the Kingdom. Prayer is not an option. In fact, it is a basic requirement. Most people don't pray. I am talking about those who claim to follow the Lord Jesus. They do not pray.

You might be sitting next to one of them right now. They pray, perhaps, when they are about to eat their meal. Or perhaps they arrive when they come to the communal worship service. But to have a lifestyle based on prayer, most people do not have that. I was like that myself until I began to study and understand the value of prayer. I think people don't pray because there is a huge misunderstanding of the concept of prayer. I have a point to make here: prayer is the most important key to the Kingdom on Earth.

It is the most important activity in the Kingdom. Prayer is more important than singing or preaching. Prayer is more important than attending a worship service. Ironically and interestingly, when Jesus came to the temple and found people worshipping there, selling goods, and performing all these temple rituals and procedures, the Bible says that he drove them out and then told them what the purpose of the building was. Do you remember what he said? He never said, "This house is called a singing house."

It is surprising that we sing for 45 minutes and then pray for 5 minutes, or we may preach for an hour and pray for two minutes. His definition of the purpose of a place of worship was not primarily those activities, but rather prayer. According to Jesus, activity in any place dedicated to God should be recognized as a place of prayer because that is what people are supposed to do there more than anything else. So perhaps it is important for us to adjust our thinking when we go to a place we call worship.

Perhaps we should say that we are going to a place to pray. Thus, Jesus made prayer more important than any other activity in our communal gathering. But he also had a personal prayer life. The question is: Why is prayer so important, even more important than preaching, singing, and rituals? The answer is interesting. Write this phrase down. Without God, man cannot, and without man, God will not. That statement relates to what is happening on the ground. From the sky.

John Wesley, one of the most remarkable spiritual leaders in history. He is the founder of the Methodist Church. He said this years ago. He was a great man of prayer. He said that the reason prayer is necessary is that it seems that without God man cannot do anything on earth, and without man God will not do anything on earth. There is a dependency that God Himself created between Him and you. In other words, what happens on Earth really depends on you.

So, prayer is making sure that God has an entry point through you to get things done from heaven on earth. If you understood that, you would never stop praying. I have given a definition of prayer in my book, and I am sure that you all have a copy of it during this period of dedication, and I hope that you will read that book again and again. But my definition of prayer to help you understand its concept simply is this. Prayer is giving God earthly permission to intervene on Earth.

God designed an arrangement between earth and heaven in such a way that man had spiritual authority on earth, and God made it necessary that man should be given access to earth through that authority that he had given man. I don't want to go into too much detail here because it would become too lengthy in education. But let me say this much. God restricted himself of his own free will with regard to reaching the earth. He restricted himself of his own free will.

He made it necessary for you to be the person who gives him the legal right to intervene on the land. This is found in Genesis, chapter 1, verse 26, where prayer was established. It is found in verse 26 when God said: “ Let them have dominion over the land.” If God had said, "Let us make man and let us rule over the earth," then prayer would have been unnecessary. But when God said, "Let them rule over the earth, " He was removing Himself from the equation and placing you as the responsible leadership on earth.

This means that God himself has, of his own volition, closed himself off from earthly affairs, and therefore if you do not allow him to enter, he cannot intervene. I can now show you a million principles in the Bible to prove that principle. In other words, prayer is not an option. It is essential; Because if we do not pray, and prayer is God granting you access to the earth through your faith and belief. If you do not grant it access, the earth cannot obtain legal intervention from heaven.

That's why God needs you. Say with me: "God needs me." You may wonder why God tolerates all your instincts, flaws, sins, and rebellion. You may wonder why God bears all the things you know about yourself that we do not know. The reason is that God will continue to forgive you and pardon you. Why? Because he needs you so much that he continues to tolerate your weaknesses. Every human being God has ever used has had weaknesses. The Bible is a record of weak people.

Moses used to swear, and even after he was filled with the power of the Lord and brought the people out of Egypt, he still swore. Remember, he cursed the rock, as the Bible says. However, God says, "I must deal with this man because I need someone to give me access." Ibrahim, whom you think was very pious, slept with the maid and fathered an illegitimate child. However, God used him to bring forth a nation because God could not bring forth the nation by Himself. He needed a human being to grant him access.

David killed Goliath, then committed adultery with a woman and killed her husband to cover it up. However, God used him to be the greatest king. Suleiman. Oh, my God. The man was very liberal. certainly. A man who loves life. However, God used it to give us the most powerful book of wisdom in the world. The Book of Proverbs. The stories never end. Why? God will put up with you because He needs you. That is why God tells you: "Please do not sin. Not just for your own good. Do not sin for My own good."

Let me quote a verse from the Prophet. If I cherish sin in my heart, the Lord will not listen to me. Look, your sin can hinder his activity on Earth. You may be literally responsible for the death and destruction of others because of your own sin. This is the weight of responsibility that God has placed upon you. Therefore, prayer is not an option for us. Fasting and prayer excite God because he is finally finding someone serious about the right of access.

These two weeks of prayer and fasting, and for some of us three weeks, are the most exciting times for God. Not yours, but God's. Because God says, "At last I have found people who are willing to seek my face." Seeking God's favor means putting yourself in a position that allows Him to use you to accomplish His will on earth. I therefore propose to you that human strength cannot be measured. Let's talk about this quickly. God has given us legal authority on Earth as human beings. Let everyone say they are human.

The word "human" is made up of two words combined. Write it down in case you don't know. When they describe you as a human being, they are describing you as a mystery. The word "human" is derived from two words. The first word is "humus" which means dust, and the second word is "man" which is the word in Greek and Hebrew "ish "; "Eish" refers to a spiritual being. Therefore, "human" is not a gender. Man is a soul. Spirits have no gender.

You will never find in the Bible any reference to a male spirit or a female spirit. This does not exist. Therefore, in every one of your bodies now there is a soul called a human being. The body inhabited by the soul has a gender. I am a male. My wife is a female human being. We are both human in the eyes of God. That is why when you read the Bible, you sometimes find that God does not address males and females. He does not speak to males and females. God speaks to man.

"If any human being hears my voice," that is not a reference to sex. One of the stupidest and most ridiculous things I have heard, coming from the Western world, especially the United States, is this preoccupation with the absurd idea of ​​sex. They even now have a holy book in which they call God "she" or "female". They are wrong. They are ignorant of a great deal. God is spirit. Spirits have no gender. How sad.

My wife lives in a female body and I live in a male body, so that when we come together we can produce more bodies for more souls to live in. Is this clear? So, if my wife and I were of the same sex and we got married, we would not have been able to provide a new home for another soul to live in. For this reason, God calls the union of two similar sexes an abomination. This is not an insult. This is a biological fact. So man is spirit and his body is dust. What is soil? Say it. soil. So here's the key.

The only spirits that possess bodies are humans, and they are the ones whom God has given authority on Earth. And God said to man, “Rule over the earth, and over the fish in the sea, and the birds in the air, and the beasts of the field, and over all the earth, and over everything that moves on the earth.” Who was he talking to? man. Who is man? Man is a soul in a body. Is this clear? God never gave those instructions to an angel. For this reason, angels are considered illegal on Earth.

Whenever I read the Bible and found an encounter with an angel, the angel always came to do work for the person. Because the angels are your servants. They are here on a mission and with permission. Let me quote a verse that might help you. It is found in the Epistle to the Hebrews. Write that down. Chapter One. Read that entire chapter tonight. It would be a great chapter to read before going to sleep. That entire chapter deals with creation and how God made the entire universe. It is a very strong chapter.

He then concludes by saying that God did not give the angels sovereignty over the earth. He talks about that in that verse of that chapter. Then he says: “Because angels are servant spirits sent to carry out the orders or instructions of those who are heirs of salvation.” These are you. The word "orders" means that you are giving them instructions. Therefore, the angel comes to Earth to report to you and do what you command him to do.

That is why God in the Bible does not permit the worship of angels, because they are not of your kind. Angels are spirits, but they do not bear the image of God. You are the only soul that bears the image of God. If you read the entire Bible, you will find that you are the only creature to whom God refers in my image. The word image means nature and characteristics. It means essence. You are part of God. God took you and put you in an earthly suit. Your body is 100% dust. You are 100% a soul.

God has placed you on Earth to be His agents, His local kings, His representatives, and His ambassadors on Earth. Then he locked himself in and said, "You have the power." Everything that happens on Earth is what you allow, impede, or stop. This is very important. Therefore, spirits that do not possess a physical body are illegal on Earth. Is this clear to everyone? Do you see the reason? Because the only spirits that God has legally granted authority on Earth are the earthly human beings, humans.

That is why prayer is essential. Therefore, any spirit on Earth without a physical earthly body is illegal. They are now on the ground, but their presence is illegitimate. That is why we call them devils. This is why demons want to possess bodies, because the body is what gives you legitimacy on Earth. You must have a physical body to perform legitimate work on Earth. This is why, when Adam and Eve picked the fruit, they sinned against God.

When God saw the woman heading towards the tree, the Almighty, the Strong, the All-Powerful, the All-Knowing of all ages, the Great and Wonderful God, could not stop a thin woman from corrupting the human race. Why? He had no body. He restricted himself. So, man fell because God is very faithful to His word. He refused to violate his own law. That is why, when Adam and Eve disobeyed God and the whole plan collapsed, God was not alarmed. God simply said to the serpent that Satan had worn.

Remember that the devil wanted to do works on Earth. Therefore, negotiate with the snake to use its body. Why? The snake's body is dust, just like yours. There was no room in Adam and Eve because they were already filled with the spirit of God. So the devil negotiated with the snake and said to her: Let me use your body. Did you know that historically it is a fact, and even from an animal and biological perspective, they have proven that the snake used to walk upright?

Whenever you find a beard skeleton anywhere, do not break it. Just look at him. You will see two places where the limbs were located. That is still present in the snake's vertebrae. She was walking upright. But when that serpent gave its body to be filled with Satan to do works with Eve, what did God say to the serpent? From this day forward you will crawl on your stomach. Why? She wasn't crawling on her belly. And you will be in the dust.

He says: "That is why snakes writhe on the ground, because their ancestors " disobeyed God and surrendered their bodies to a jobless gorilla." But God said to Satan, in Genesis 3:15, “Write this down.” I will quote what he said. God said to Satan, “He was not speaking to Adam and Eve.” He was talking to the snake, the devil that was inside the snake. He says, "I will rephrase it." You know that I cannot intervene now because you know what you have established. She used to live with me.

You know I would never break my promise. So I make a promise to you. The promise was given to him in 3:15. He says: "The same woman you used to destroy this, I will use the same woman, and she will create a body for me, and I will legally enter the human race with a body, and I will legally smash your head and reclaim what you stole from my children and return it to them." "That was the promise of Christ to come in Jesus." So, Jesus is the body and Christ is the spirit.

Therefore, when Isaiah saw this miracle thousands of years later, Isaiah said, "I see a mystery that no one will understand." The virgin will conceive and give birth, and we will call him Emmanuel. "Mim" means "in". "Anu" means " humans" and "El" means "God". Emmanuel simply means God in human flesh. This is the seventh chapter of Isaiah. In chapter nine, Isaiah says: “For unto us a child is born, ” this is the part relating to the flesh, “and a son is given.” "This is the part related to the soul."

The boy made the son legally. Write this down. Christ is the Son. Jesus is the boy. That's why we call him Jesus Christ. In fact, it should be written this way. Jesus Christ. The "al" should always be in the middle because it refers to a person who lives inside a person. You yourself are incarnate. You are a soul living in a body. You are incarnate. In order to live among us legally, he also had to be incarnate. That's why he came. It came about legally because of this wonderful law.

The law states that nothing can happen on Earth unless the soul has a body. Is this clear? So when you hear people say they saw a ghost, or that their aunt came to visit them, or that their cousin showed up last night, that's not true. No spirit can be here without permission unless it has a body. That's why when you die, you leave. Have you noticed that when someone dies physically, they pass away? Because the body is what made it legal here. You never die. No one ever truly dies. It is the body that dies.

The thing that makes them legal dies. When you lose your body, you become useless to the earth. That is why Ibrahim cannot speak to us today. Therefore, those philosophies you learned about some saints returning to do works for you are not biblical. They are not legal. I remember the story of Saul when Saul died. Samuel died. Excuse me, the prophet Samuel died and Saul, as you know, was the king and Saul consulted him. Samuel was giving advice. Did you say Saul? Samuel was giving advice to Saul. Good.

When Samuel died, Saul wanted to get some advice. But Samuel is dead. It is illegal. The Bible says that Saul went to a witch. Yes. A fortune-teller woman. This is found in the Bible. He said to her: I will pay you a lot of money if you take me to Samuel's tomb and bring his spirit so that I may speak with him and he may give me advice. This woman took his money, as they always did, and took it to the burial ground where Samuel was buried.

The Bible says that the Lord was angry with Saul because the Lord says that Saul committed the sin of rebellion, which is divination. I will explain that one day, but I will explain why the word rebellion was used. We cannot deal with it now due to time constraints. But God cursed Saul because, according to the Bible, when the woman carried out her tricks, a spirit appeared and looked like Samuel. The Bible says that God called that spirit the familiar spirit. Say it with me. A familiar spirit.

Familiar means that it is a demonic spirit that has learned someone's habits and impersonates him. Therefore, they have familiar habits that resemble that person. If your aunt comes to visit you, that is not your aunt. Yes. This is why God hates divination, because it is an attempt to break His law. There are demons impersonating your son, daughter, aunt, uncle, bishop, or whoever you are trying to summon. That is why God hates fortune-telling. Are you with me? Don't be deceived by lies.

Such a thing does not exist. You have power over these demons. Yes. Because you have a body. Yes. They don't own one. Let us applaud God for the strength of your bodies. So here's the principle that connects all of this. Here's what that means. Write this phrase down. It simply means that nothing on Earth can happen without human permission. A human being. That's why you should pray. Prayer is the activation by man of the permission given to God to intervene in the affairs of the earth because man has authority.

God has the power. Man possesses power. God has the ability. Humans have the right to give permission. God can do anything, but He cannot do it without your permission. This is the reason for our prayers. You are doing many things that please God this week.

God was finally waiting for a group of people to stop what they were doing and say, "Now I can do something in your country, in your home, in your family, in your work, in your bodies, in your children, and in your relationships, because I have gained access through your supplication." I therefore propose to you that there are some principles of prayer. I extracted seven of them. Please get me the book. There are more than 29 principles in the book.

Number one, the legal authority to control the land was given only to humans, to man. Number two, God did not include himself within the structure of legal authority on earth. Number three, man became the legal agent of the terrestrial domain. Number four, only spirits that inhabit a physical body are legal on Earth. By the way, this is why you can exorcise demons. You have the power to exorcise a demon. No angel has ever expelled a demon from Earth. You will never find that anywhere in the Bible.

Only humans can do that because angels do not have a body, or at least not a body that they retain. Sometimes, you know, in the Bible, you find that God allowed an angel with certain tasks to incarnate in a tangible form, but that wasn't really a human body process. That is why those angels were not born through humans. No angel was given authority on Earth. And number five, any spirit without a body is considered illegal on Earth. Number six, any supernatural influence on Earth is only legal through a human being.

That's why God needs me. That's why God needs you. Number seven, God made himself subject to this law. You know, here's a question. Why doesn't God stop all the crimes in your country? He has the ability to do that. The answer is, he needs permission. Why doesn't God, who loves everyone, save them without their permission? He cannot. In fact, God doesn't even preach to humans. He cannot do that. So God says, "How will they know unless someone is sent to them?" "And how can someone be sent unless he is chosen?"

It's as if God is stuck with you. Why doesn't God speak to your aunt who suffers from alcoholism himself? He wants you to go and talk to her because he needs to reach her through you. So the essence of prayer is that you write very slowly. Here is the law of prayer. Therefore, the law of prayer is that legal authority on earth is in the hands of humans. This means that God will never violate that law. It is a word he will never break.

For this reason, nothing will happen and nothing can happen on Earth without humans. That's why you are so important as a young man, and as a young woman. That's why God needs you to pray as a father and as a mother. God cannot even save your children unless you begin by giving God permission. That's why prayer is so important. God cannot intervene on Earth without human cooperation. He needs someone to cooperate with. I could have given all these examples, but I just want you to understand the principle.

When God wanted to destroy Sodom and Gomorrah. He couldn't. He had to find a human being to give him permission. So, he went to Abraham. Abraham was able to make deals with God. I'm talking about heavyweight deals because Ibrahim discovered his own strength. He made deals with God. He said to God, “You cannot touch that city, but bring out every righteous person from it. My nephew is in that city; his name is Lot. You cannot touch that city because you said that you would not destroy the righteous with the wicked.”

"My nephew is there, and I will not give you permission to do that yet." And God said to Abraham, “You have spoken the truth.” " Go and take your nephew." When Moses was at the Red Sea, an interesting example, he had a million people behind him, slaves coming out of Egypt, and he had a body of water in front of him, and Pharaoh was coming to kill him. And Moses began to cry out to God. Then God said, “O Moses, what is this that is in your hand?” He said, "A stick."

So he said to him, "Okay, lift it up and tell me what to do." Why couldn't God simply open the water? He needed permission. So Moses took his staff and stretched it out. God said: "Say something." open. God said, "Thank you." The force came to open the water. Now, interestingly, the water never closed. That's why it became dangerous. Because God only told him to open it. The Israelites crossed the water on dry land.

When they reached the other side, they turned around and saw Pharaoh and his army coming across the water. Why? Why didn't God simply shut off the water? God said, "You didn't tell me to close it." So Moses said to the Lord, “Lord, what should I do?” God said, "Turn around and tell me to close it." Moses, close it. God said, "Thank you very much. " Then he drowned everyone. Some of you asked God to open a door last week, and the door is still open and you are not asking Him to close it.

The power of prayer is to give God permission to act on earth. Never think that you are wasting your time on the correct prayer, and I use the term correct prayer. That's why we teach prayer here. It is extremely important. So let's consider the definitions of prayer. Prayer is for humans to give God legal permission, access, and the right to intervene in the affairs of the earth. Prayer is the release of man into the dominion of the Kingdom of Heaven on earth. Prayer is God fulfilling His word to man.

Prayer is giving man an earthly license for heavenly intervention. All of these are definitions of prayer. And when you actually associate it with this word, you begin to understand what it means. The word prayer means the word plea. It does not refer to religious activity. Prayer is not a religious word. It is the Hebrew word for petition. A petition is a legal term. It is a call to demand a government based on constitutional rights protected by law.

In other words, prayer is literally citizens demanding from their government the rights guaranteed to them by law. All countries have petitions. You could actually petition the government right now to stop the referendum, but you don't know that it's your right. It is your right because you are a citizen. But they don't want you to know all your rights because then you would be able to do things they don't want you to do. Ignorant citizens are a joy to the politician.

Prayer is you and I demanding that our government implement what the government promised to do in its territory. Therefore, the petition is a reminder to the government of what it has constitutionally promised its citizens. So, in my hands now is the constitution of our country, Heaven. This Constitution contains all the rights, privileges, and promises of our government. That's why when you pray, you don't need to invent prayers.

You simply recall the constitutional promises of your government, and then use your faith and belief to demand that they be implemented on the ground because you are a law-abiding citizen. So, if you are not born again and filled with the Holy Spirit, you cannot use this document because you are an illegal citizen, or an illegal immigrant. Sorry, you are not legal. That is why the Bible says that many will say, “Lord, Lord,” and I will say to them, “I do not know you.”

You boast among people as if you are one of us. He says, but deep down, you never got your passport. You were not born again. You can only pray to God if you are a legal citizen, excuse me, a legal citizen. Therefore, you must ensure that your life is always in line with the government before you begin making demands of that government. There are citizens in the Bahamas who break the law. Isn't that so? Where are they? In your country's prisons. Why?

Because they violated the laws that granted them access to the laws and freedoms of the Constitution. Therefore, they could no longer make demands. They cannot demand what they want to eat. They eat what is offered to them. They cannot demand what they want to wear. They wear what the prisons give them. And there are spiritual people like these. They come to God to make a claim. God says, "How can you demand things when you break the law? You live your life as you please. You have illicit relationships.

You do shameful things and then come here to pray. How can you demand things from me based on what you did last night?" This is no secret. We come before God to present our demands. God says, "If I harbor iniquity in my heart, the Lord will not listen to my plea." Prayer involves, first and foremost, making your life right in the eyes of God.

That is why your first act in prayer is to confess your sin to make sure that everything is covered, and to keep that cover so that you can pray 24 hours a day without the door of access being closed to you. This is why we live a righteous life. So that God can use us to bring about change on Earth. Is this clear? Therefore, prayer is an earthly declaration of heavenly intervention.

This simply means that prayer is the exercise by man of his legal authority on earth to invoke the influence of heaven on planet Earth. You are essential to God. God needs you. Never forget that. God needs me and you so badly that He will repair and heal you in order to keep your body on Earth. Healing is provided by God because your body needs it, not because you need it. That's why you should pray for your healing in a different way. You don't pray to be healed in order to feel better. This is a selfish motive.

Rather say: “Oh God, this cancerous tumor in my breast came to destroy me. And now, I say to you, God, I don’t need this body as much as you do. In fact, I would rather leave this body because being absent from the body is being present with you. But you have more work to do on earth, so I remove this thing from my body for your sake.” Observe how God begins to heal immediately if you pray correctly. That is why Jacob says: “ You ask and do not receive, because you ask wrongly.”

"You are asking for the wrong reason." This is what the word "badly" means. The motive is wrong. I feel pain. Lord, remove this pain. God says: "Why should I remove the pain?" And you're still watching TV for 5 hours. I will remove the pain if you spend some time praying with me so that I can accomplish my work through this body. We wonder why we ask the wrong thing. I maintain my physical health because God needs it. That's why God was so strict about cleanliness.

When the Israelites left Egypt, there were chapters and chapters in the Bible. God told them what to eat, what not to eat, what to drink, and what He knew about this body. He says, " Look, I don't want you to destroy this body because I need it." God told them: "Do not eat pork." I won't pry into your private lives now, but let me tell you something. If they told you how much bacteria are in pork fat that heat cannot kill, you would get sick. God created certain animals to act as vacuum cleaners.

The pig is one of them. I'm going to get into trouble. I know that. Don't go near that. The catfish is a vacuum cleaner. Don't rush me. A lobster is a vacuum cleaner. Oh, my God. Oh my God. Let's leave this part aside. Shrimp is a vacuum cleaner. Oh my God. Father, forgive us, for we know exactly what we are doing. But God gave them instructions. Why? None of the instructions were related to their spirit. She was attached to that body. Because he knew he needed that body.

Why do you think God created your body to live forever? I have studied the number of years of humanity after Adam. 900 years. 800 years. God did not design it for you, but for Himself. He never wanted you to lose your body. And for this reason, because of your intense sadness, you will be resurrected. Because you are of no use to God in heaven. The resurrection is God fulfilling His word to ensure that you have a physical body when you return to Earth so that He will always have access to you.

Incidentally, this is why Jesus Christ will return. It is still legal. The Holy Spirit is here now only because He dwells in your body. You are making the Holy Spirit legal. That is why it is not called the body of Jesus, because that is in heaven. It is a beautiful body, a new body. Whose body are you? For Christ, not for Jesus. You are the body of the soul. Therefore, the Bible says: "Whose temple is your body?" Holy Spirit. Therefore, the following phrase is used: "Keep it pure." He tells you that. Why?

Because the Holy Spirit has no legal place if it does not possess your body. You are very important to God. Fasting makes the Holy Spirit enthusiastic because he doesn't need to compete with peas, rice, potato salad, and tacos. It does n't need to compete with fried eggs and bacon in the morning. He has a body he focuses on with a powerful combination, a pure physical body filled with the Holy Spirit. This is work for God. That's why God loves you when you fast. He loves you a little more.

That's why the devil doesn't want you to fast. He will fight you. It will make you eat two peanuts tomorrow. Just to break your fast and crush your conscience to feel guilty. These are devilish things. Because he knows the strength you gain when you are fasting. Become available to God. Is this okay? Good. Let me explain to you why prayer is necessary. Prayer is necessary because God cannot break His word. Secondly, prayer is necessary because heaven depends on man.

Third, prayer is necessary because God does not violate the authority He established. Fourth, prayer is necessary because man needs God to live on earth, and God needs man to work on earth. Fifth, prayer is necessary because the Kingdom of Heaven cannot come to Earth without it. The Kingdom of God cannot manifest itself on earth without us giving God permission to do so. Is this clear? Do you understand that? That's why you should pray all the time.

When you walk down the street, when you are in the city, when you are in the grocery store, when you are driving to work, you should pray all the time. I mean, the Bible says to pray without ceasing. Why? When it stops, the heavens close their gates. Every time you stop, stumbling means stopping. When you stop praying, God stops working. People should always pray. Is this possible? Yes. Even when you are asleep, your soul can pray. What should we pray for? We pray once a month. So, a whole month.

You wonder why your life is so turbulent. Everything is corrupt in your life, in your family, in your work, and in your studies. She says, "What? " Because God says, "Because you only visit me once a month... " You only send your requests once a month. So, for the entire month I cannot intervene because you have disabled the system. Prayer should be offered at all times and without getting tired of it. Jesus says that prayer is necessary for God. Prayer was the one thing the disciples asked Jesus to teach them.

I want to conclude this section about Jesus here. We will now talk about the life of Jesus, why he prayed so much, and what he said about prayer. If you had lived with Jesus for three and a half years, seen the things he did, and been part of the group, I don't think you would have asked him to teach you how to pray. I saw a man who walked on water, cleansed lepers, raised the dead, drove out demons, opened blind eyes, opened ears, and loosened mute tongues. He literally made the food multiply.
